mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.friend_id AS friendId, a.ticket AS friendTicket, f.friend_party AS friendParty FROM friend f JOIN account a ON f.friend_id = a.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.ticket DESC, f.friend_party DESC, f.id ASC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.friend_id AS friendId, a.ticket AS friendTicket, f.friend_party AS friendParty FROM friend f JOIN account a ON f.friend_id = a.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} and a.ticket = 1 ORDER BY a.ticket DESC, f.friend_party DESC, f.id ASC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.friend_id AS friendId, a.ticket AS friendTicket, f.friend_party AS friendParty FROM friend f JOIN account a ON f.friend_id = a.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} and a.ticket = 1 and a.att_id is null ORDER BY a.ticket DESC, f.friend_party DESC, f.id ASC
